description: The bar chart illustrates the F1 Score (%) achieved by different model configurations across six datasets. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "Dataset", and displays the datasets in the following order: SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "F1 Score (%)", featuring a linear scale that ranges from 60 to 100 with tick marks at regular intervals of 10. The chart utilizes grouped bars, with four bars clustered together for each dataset category. According to the legend positioned below the chart, the colors represent specific model variations: green for "MADLLM", purple for "MADLLM w/o feature embedding", blue for "MADLLM w/o prompt pool", and brown for "MADLLM w/o skip embedding". Across the chart, the green "MADLLM" bars consistently display the highest values within each dataset group. The tallest bar overall is the green "MADLLM" bar in the PSM dataset group, reaching approximately 97%. Conversely, the shortest bar is the purple "MADLLM w/o feature embedding" bar in the WADI dataset group, indicating a value of approximately 62%. Other approximate values include the blue bar at 77% for PSM and 69% for SMAP, and the brown bar at 67% for SMAP. The dataset categories on the horizontal axis are not sorted alphabetically or strictly by value. All bars are visually outlined with a thin black border, and no specific visual emphasis is applied to any individual bar.
